## What's new

Threadnote 5.3.4 makes `threadnote index rebuild` wait for both lexical and semantic recall to be ready, and reports when changed inputs prevent a trustworthy rebuild.

### Ready when rebuild finishes

`threadnote index rebuild` now completes only after it has refreshed both lexical search and semantic recall for the inputs it inspected. If those inputs change while rebuilding, Threadnote reports the drift instead of presenting an out-of-date result as current.

### Everyday work stays in the background

Normal saves and repair workflows keep their existing asynchronous refresh behavior. Use `threadnote index rebuild` when you need a foreground confirmation that recall is current.
